# test.reset — POST /test/reset

Reset all data

Deletes all users, tokens, posts and comments, and restarts ids from 1. Exists only when the server runs with `TEST_MODE=1`.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.test.reset()
res.assert(200)
```

## Responses
```ts
200: {
  "ok": boolean
}
```
